title: UK online grocer Ocado's stock closed down 17.4% on November 18 after its US partner Kroger said it would close three automated warehouses in January 2026 (Reuters)
summary: Reuters:UK online grocer Ocado's stock closed down 17.4% on November 18 after its US partner Kroger said it would close three automated warehouses in January 2026—  - US firm Kroger is Ocado's most important partner  — Kroger says three automated warehouses to close in January
